title: God, Whose Almighty Word
description: God, Whose Almighty Word in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 4 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by John Marriott, first published in 1813. The tune, ITALIAN HYMN, is by Felice de Giardini (1769). This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: God, whose al-might_-y word Cha-os and dark__-ness heard And took their flight: Hear us, we hum-ble pray, And where the Gos-pel day Sheds not its glor-ious ray, Let there be light!

lines: Lord, who once came to bring,
Health to the sick in mind,
Through the earth, far and wide,

topics: God's Children - the Faithful (see also Saints, People of the World)
licence: Public domain. The Open Hymnal Project marks this hymn “copyright: public domain” (words, music and setting), and places its own editing, indexes and data files in the public domain.
credits: Melody and words from the Open Hymnal Project (openhymnal.org), edited by Brian J. Dumont; public domain.
